jcr_content.jcr:title: IBASE ET875 Industrial Mini-ITX Motherboard
jcr_content.jcr:description: An industrial-grade Mini-ITX motherboard designed for embedded computing applications. Visit Macnica Americas to get a quote on the IBASE ET875 for sale.

text.text:
Engineered for Excellence in Embedded Applications

The ET875 from IBASE is an industrial-grade Mini-ITX motherboard designed for embedded computing applications. It supports 8th and 9th generation Intel® Core™ processors with the LGA1151 socket, offering scalable performance options. With two DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 64GB of memory, the motherboard ensures efficient multitasking and data processing capabilities. It provides rich connectivity options, including multiple USB ports, LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort interfaces, enabling versatile peripheral integration. The ET875 motherboard also offers expansion capabilities with PCIe and Mini PCIe slots, accommodating additional hardware components for customized functionality.

• Support for 8th and 9th generation Intel® Core™ processors
  • Two DDR4 DIMM slots supporting up to 64GB of memory
  • Rich connectivity options including USB, LAN, HDMI, and DisplayPort interfaces
  • Expansion capabilities with PCIe and Mini PCIe slots
  • Industrial-grade design for reliability and longevity
